ActionSpec.description: Parsed and validated so the spec is complete; nothing executes it before Phase 3.
ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

AuthQuery.description:
A secret sent as a query parameter, for APIs that accept nothing else (SABnzbd's
``apikey``; Jellyfin's ``ApiKey``, the one form not behind its legacy switch). Added
2026-09-25; a new auth type is dashboard/v1-compatible (§11.3a). A URL is where secrets
leak, so the value is masked in every log line and provider error (hud.config.redact)
— but the target app's own access log is beyond HUD's reach: point base_url at the
container, not through a reverse proxy that logs query strings.
AuthQuery.title: AuthQuery

AuthSettings.description: Which identity backends run, in precedence order (PLAN.md §10.1).
AuthSettings.title: AuthSettings

BarsWidget.description:
One metric across many resources: per-core CPU, busiest containers. Added
2026-09-26; a new widget type is dashboard/v1-compatible (§11.3a).
BarsWidget.title: BarsWidget

ForwardAuthSettings.description: Trusted-proxy header auth. Header names are config so any forward-auth provider fits.
ForwardAuthSettings.title: ForwardAuthSettings

Grid.description: 1-based cell position on the ``lg`` grid; smaller breakpoints reflow in the SPA.
Grid.title: Grid

ProviderSpec.description:
Either tier, one envelope.

* Tier 1 (declarative): ``transport`` + ``resources[]``.
* Tier 2 (plugin): ``plugin`` (its registered name) + ``config`` (validated by the
  plugin's own config model at build time; ``${secret:}`` and ``${VAR}`` apply).
ProviderSpec.title: ProviderSpec

RbacSpec.description:
``defaults.unmatched_group`` need not be listed under ``groups``: an unlisted group
grants nothing, which is the safe reading.
RbacSpec.title: RbacSpec

Requirement.description: One placeholder the user must supply before a template works.
Requirement.title: Requirement

Retention.description: Retention per tier (PLAN.md §6.2). Stored as the user wrote them; parsed on demand.
Retention.title: Retention

TemplateInfo.description:
Display metadata a bundled template carries (PLAN.md §8.5.1). Harmless on a
hand-written provider; the wizard catalog reads it in Phase 3.
TemplateInfo.title: TemplateInfo

UnsupportedWidget.description: Any type this build cannot render. Kept verbatim so write-back preserves it.
UnsupportedWidget.title: UnsupportedWidget
